M4 v1.0: SQL-truncated training data port (delta-data::m4_schema::query_run_visible_final_bars / query_next_training_step_bar / query_training_visible_corporate_actions, delta-app::training::TrainingDataPort), PIT split adjustment (delta-core::sim::derive_point_in_time_split_adjusted_bars), SHA-256 deterministic candidate-pool sampling with pre-start redraws, and hidden-mode DTO scrubbing across desktop, CLI and AI until explicit post-finish reveal (M4-K01, M4-A-01..03, M4-A-16, M4-A-18; H-05 manual check not-run).

M4 v1.0: pure Decimal spot long-only matching engine delta-core::sim (m4-sim-1) supporting Market, Limit, StopMarket, OCO and entry orders with AttachedBracket (DAY/GTC), t+1 open eligibility, fixed O->L->H->C path with ambiguous-fill counting, 1.10x market buy cash buffer, shared OCO reservation, INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS / INSUFFICIENT_POSITION / whole-order INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS_AT_FILL rejections, tick/lot nearest-valid hints, pre-open split adjustment & corporate_action_split cancellation, and ex-date cash dividend credit (M4-A-03..06, M4-A-15, M4-A-16).

M4 v1.0: composable FeeProfileVersion and settle_order_fees (notional rate, per-unit, fixed per-order, per-order min/max settled once at order end across partial fills, quote or received_asset fee currency, HalfUp/HalfEven/Up/Down rounding, PerFill/PerOrder tier, independent directional slippage and half-spread), immutable SQLite/Rust version freezing on run start, and 3 explicit scenario-assumption built-ins (zero_cost, us_equity_per_share_example, crypto_rate_example; Futu/OKX presets deferred in LOOP-06) (M4-A-04, M4-A-07, M4-A-08).

M4 v1.0: Schema 5 migration with pre-migration consistency backup (before-schema-4-*), 8 simulation/training tables isolated from real ledger (ledger_revision unchanged), single-savepoint commit_simulation_step_atomic, Initial/Periodic20/Pause/Finish checkpoints, subprocess crash_mid_advance recovery, 3-way bit-for-bit state_hash deterministic replay (Scratch / FromCheckpoint / second process), tamper detection marking runs damaged, child retry runs (parent_run_id), backup/restore, simulation export and delete preview (M4-K02, M4-A-02, M4-A-08..11, M4-A-18).

M4 v1.0: pure Decimal training report delta-core::sim_report (m4-report-1) computing return, realized/unrealized PnL, total fees, close-to-close equity curve & max drawdown, exposure, closed trade group win rate (zero-PnL separated), profit factor & payoff ratio (explicit NoClosedTrades/NoLosses/NoWins states), expectancy with sample count, post-entry/pre-exit path-bounded MAE/MFE, PlanExecutionSummary, identical-cost Buy-and-Hold benchmark and structured SampleLimitations across UI and CLI (M4-A-12, M4-A-15; H-05 manual check not-run).

M4 v1.0: in-session training_note recording with or without orders, post-finish archive to journal labelled 来自模拟训练 (real ledger untouched), separate user self-evaluation, post-finish-only ScopeTarget::TrainingRun read-only AI gateway (5 training.* tools) with openable SIM-ORD-*/SIM-FILL-*/TRN-NOTE-* citations, fabricated-citation & financial-number verification across both protocols on loopback SSE, prompt-injection defense and offline resilience (M4-A-13, M4-A-14, M4-A-16; real model M4-L-01 awaits optional ACT-01).
